basic_profile.name: Dr. Srishti Batra
basic_profile.headline: Founder and CEO at qZense Labs | Transforming fresh supply chain with AI | Alumna: NCBS-TIFR  and IISER-M
basic_profile.summary:
Dr. Srishti Batra is the Co-Founder and CTO of qZense Labs, recipient of India's National Technology Award 2023 for pioneering AI-driven sensors that assess fresh food quality using artificial olfaction, spectral sensing, and computer vision. Holding a PhD in Neuroscience and Olfaction from NCBS-TIFR and a BS-MS from IISER Mohali, she brings over 13 years of expertise in biology, bioinformatics, and data science, with achievements including BIRAC grants, granted patents, Shark Tank India features, Forbes Asia 100 to Watch recognition, and a special guest honor at the 75th Republic Day Parade. She actively mentors women and entrepreneurs in STEM.

Areas of expertise : entrepreneurship, sensory biology, sense of smell, life science research, data science

Personal Blog: https://srishtibatra.wordpress.com/

past.employer_linkedin_description: One of the nation’s largest schools, the University of Minnesota offers baccalaureate, master’s, and doctoral degrees in virtually every field—from medicine to business, law to liberal arts, and science and engineering to architecture. The University of Minnesota system is made up of five campuses in Minnesota including Crookston, Duluth, Morris, Rochester, and the Twin Cities (Minneapolis/St. Paul). University of Minnesota Extension provides outreach and education services to Minnesota's communities through science-based knowledge, expertise and training.The University of Minnesota was recognized by Forbes in 2018 in the Best Employer, Best Employer for Diversity, and Best Employer for New Grads categories.
past.employee_description:
Research Intern at department of chemistry, University of Minnesota, USA. Received prestigious khorana fellowship to study drug design in cancer research.
The focus of this project was to understand interactions between two critical proteins which plays an important role in progression of  Acute myeloid leukemia (AML), a type of blood cancer. The  two proteins : KIX and CREB interaction is involved in progression of acute myeloid leukemia. I worked on incorporating Fluorinated tryptophan in the protein KIX, so as to study structural and functional characterization using  Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR). I worked on structural and functional characterization of fluorinated tryptophan KIX and understanding its role in AML

past.employer_linkedin_description: IGIB mission " To translate concepts developed in basic biological research to commercially viable technologies for health care ".IGIB has transformed itself into one of the premier laboratories under CSIR, by carrying out path breaking Research & Development activities in various areas of modern biotechnology and biological sciences such as allergy and infectious diseases, molecular pathogenesis and recombinant DNA technology while focusing mainly on Genomics and Bio-informatics. The research activities/projects of the Institute can be classified under the "Discovery Research" and "Collaborative Research". The projects under the Discovery research i.e. the projects, which are assigned by CSIR, are either performed by the Institute or are executed under collaborative arrangement along with other constituent laboratories of CSIR. Besides this IGIB also Undertakes collaborative & sponsored research with various Government and non-Government institutions/companies, at a national level.
past.employee_description:
Title:  Understand developmental roles of protein FoxD3 by creating neural crest ablations in Zebrafish embryos.

Description:  Worked on Knocking down (loss of function) transcription factor FoxD3 which is an important factor in embryonic development specifically in neural crest development. I reported the abnormalities in the zebrafish embryos upon neural crest ablations by knocking down factor FoxD3

past.employer_name: Centre for DNA fingerprinting and Diagnostics, hyderabad
past.employee_description:
Title: Understanding the role of Iron dependent regulation in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
Description: Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) is a pathogenic bacterial species and the causative agent of tuberculosis in humans. The iron-dependent regulator (IdeR) is a well-characterized global regulator responsible for maintaining iron homeostasis in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB). The binding partners (DNA motifs) to this were predicted by computational tool. This project focused on validating those novel binding sites using molecular tools and binding studies.

Graduate Research Scholar in Naturalist Inspired Chemical Ecology(NICE) lab at National Centre for Biological Sciences(NCBS), Bangalore, India. Worked towards understanding how different insects have evolved to smell “odor objects” and make decisions (i.e. select actions). Neurobiology of olfaction and chemical ecology.
Key words: olfaction, ecology
links:
http://nice.ncbs.res.in/
https://www.ncbs.res.in/

schools.school: National Centre for biological Sciences (NCBS) - Tata Institue of Fundamental Research (TIFR)
